### The Giver Gets the Glory
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/the-giver-gets-the-glory
Passage: 2 Thessalonians 1:11–12
Points:
- God chooses to magnify His glory through showing grace toward His people.
- Believers' good resolves and works of faith are empowered entirely by God.
- Because God provides the enabling power, He receives all the glory for what is accomplished.
- Depending on divine help keeps Christians humble and joyful while honoring God as supreme.
- Daily Christian living is good news because God answers prayer by supplying fresh grace to obey.
